description: This file contains functions for converting hexadecimal string representations to internal object identifiers and vice versa, specifically used in Git's hash management. It involves parsing, formatting, and handling hash algorithms.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex_algop(const char * hex,unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a hash using a specified hash algorithm. Processes each byte according to the algorithm's size.

methods.name: int get_hash_hex(const char * hex,unsigned char * sha1)
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a SHA-1 hash using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hex string to an object_id structure, setting the algorithm used and zero-padding if needed.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a hex string into an object_id using multiple hash algorithms, returning the index of the matched algorithm.

methods.name: int get_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Uses the default hash algorithm to parse a hex string into an object_id.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_algop(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id with algorithm info, updating the end pointer.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex_any(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Tries multiple algorithms to parse a hex string into an object_id, updating the end pointer.

methods.name: int parse_oid_hex(const char * hex,struct object_id * oid,const char ** end)
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop_r(char * buffer,const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Converts a hash to its hexadecimal string representation using a specified algorithm, output to provided buffer.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex_r(char * buffer,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object_id to hex string using the associated hash algorithm.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex_algop(const unsigned char * hash,const struct git_hash_algo * algop)
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string of a hash using a specified algorithm, manages internal buffer cycling.

methods.name: char * hash_to_hex(const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Converts a hash to its hex string using the default algorithm.

methods.name: char * oid_to_hex(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Converts an object_id to hex string representation.
